articles.title: S&P downgrades Flowers Foods to ‘BB’ on earnings pressure and covenant risks
articles.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings lowered its issuer credit rating on Flowers Foods Inc (NYSE:FLO) to ‘BB’ from ‘BB+’ on Nov. 23, 2026, assigning a negative outlook as persistent demand headwinds and elevated input costs weigh on profitability. The agency also downgraded the packaged bakery company's senior unsecured notes to ‘BB’ from ‘BB+’ with a ‘3’ recovery rating, signaling an expected recovery of 50% to 70% in a default scenario.
